extraction.client-core: Existing light client types plus client-base chinese_conversion.rs and pinned OpenCC inputs, and client-core host-context punctuation policy functions/types (snapshot serde derives only for the thin ABI); no client services.
extraction.input-runtime examples: Excluded: require full client-core resource service outside the Owl extraction.
extraction.test data: Shared punctuation contract, grammar model lock and public nine-key sentences; retain prior synthetic helpcode fixture instead of restricted author tables.

adaptations: Local path dependency to the separately pinned chinese-ime-lm crate.
Public root/path validator exports used by the C ABI.
Candidate emoji live toggle and cached-candidate view exposure.
Wubi independent Z lookup switch; pinned suffix-only reverse lookup, native mixed candidate code-row identity and group order.
Wubi follows native phrase holding and upstream sentence-alternative defaults, shared with ordinary pinyin.
Host-loaded verified keyboard model handoff and live candidate refresh through existing neural lattice scorer; no synchronous model file read on the key path.
Native host-context smart punctuation uses upstream route/repeat/space-convert decisions; C ABI transports JSON without changing candidate IDs.

Owl enhancement boundary: quick_phrase_table_in_candidates defaults true upstream; Owl false requires explicit K plus a complete host trigger. Native database quick phrases retain ordinary placement and K prefix browsing; no native candidate algorithm change.

Native host adapters expose existing runtime Finish and paired-book balance actions; Swift mirrors the pinned macOS marked-closing tail and quote reopening contract. Application chords finish before passthrough; slash-to-English remains an explicit Owl product exception.

Native quick-phrase capability is distinct from fresh mixed_input.quick_phrase=false; live preference forwarding queues until runtime idle and preserves composition. One shared preference preserves its existing storage key; Pinyin and Wubi use pinned pre-mixing placement/counts.
